ja230:1.1: Measureless are the banners, endless on all sides,
ja230:1.2: As hard to overcome as the ocean by crows,
ja230:1.3: As hard to overcome as a mountain by wind,
ja230:1.4: As hard to overcome as am I now by such.
ja230:2.1: Fool, do not talk this nonsense, such is not his,
ja230:2.2: When on fire do not receive one who obstructs you,
ja230:2.3: You attack like a solitary elephant,
ja230:2.4: Like one who crushes a reed with his foot.
